description_en: Retrieves call details from a specified instance that match the search criteria
description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定搜索条件过滤后的通话详情列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-call-detail-records-v2 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --start-time 1657853640015 --end-time 1657879880010 --sort-order DESC --instance-id ccc-test --order-by-field startTime --search-pattern 'text:请稍后_AND_accessChannelUserId:af1a0-afaa-5086e2946e0b0_AND_accessChannelName:专属开发渠道0' --media-type AUDIO --contact-id-list '["job-123456789","job-234567891"]' --contact-type-list '["INBOUND","OUTBOUND"]' --contact-disposition-list '["Success","NoAnswer"]' --early-media-state-list '["NotConnected","NoAnswer"]' --satisfaction-survey-channel IVR --satisfaction-rate-list '["-1","3"]' --satisfaction-description-list '["满意","一般"]' --skill-group-id-list '["skg1@ccc-test","skg2@ccc-test"]' --agent-id agent@ccc-test --first-agent-id agent@ccc-test --calling-number 1910009993 --called-number 1910009993 --number 1910009993 --broker 02100004972 --access-channel-type-list '["Web","AliMe"]' --release-initiator-list AGENT --release-reason-list VisitorInitiatedClosure_,_AgentInitiatedClosure --analytics-report-ready true --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCallDetailRecordsV2

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页序号，范围1-100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，范围1-100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query, specified as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Defaults to 00:00:00 on the current day
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的起始时间，默认为当天的 0 时，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query, specified as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Defaults to the current time
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的终止时间，默认为当前时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the results. The default value is `DESC`.

Valid values:

`ASC`: Ascending order.

`DESC`: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，默认为降序。

枚举值：

ASC：升序。

DESC：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center instance
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The field for sorting the results. The default is `startTime`.

Valid value:

`startTime`: the start time of the call
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，非必填，默认为 startTime（通话开始时间）。

枚举值：

startTime：通话开始时间
parameters.name: order_by_field

parameters.example: text:请稍后 AND accessChannelUserId:af1a0-afaa-5086e2946e0b* AND accessChannelName:专属开发渠道*
parameters.help_en:
A custom query string that follows the Lucene query syntax.

The following fields and query types are supported:

`accessChannelUserId`: The visitor ID. Exact and fuzzy searches are supported.

`accessChannelName`: The channel name. Exact and fuzzy searches are supported.

`text`: The conversation text. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh:
自定义查询文本，遵循Lucene查询语法。

支持查询字段和查询类型列表：

accessChannelUserId: 访客ID，支持精准查询和模糊查询。

accessChannelName: 渠道名称，支持精准查询和模糊查询。

text: 会话文本，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: search_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The media type.

Valid values:

`AUDIO`: audio.

`VIDEO`: video.

`CHAT`: chat message.

`ALL`: all media types
parameters.help_zh:
媒体类型。

枚举值：

AUDIO：语音。

VIDEO：视频。

CHAT: 消息。

ALL: 所有
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en: A list of call IDs
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID列表
parameters.name: contact_id_list

parameters.help_en:
A list of call types to include in the results.

Valid values:

`OUTBOUND`: outbound call.

`BACK2BACK`: back-to-back call.

`PRIVACY_DIAL`: privacy dial.

`INTERNAL`: internal call.

`PREDICTIVE`: predictive dialing.

`INBOUND`: inbound call.

`CONFERENCE`: conference call
parameters.help_zh:
按通话类型列表过滤。

枚举值：

OUTBOUND：呼出。

BACK2BACK：双呼。

PRIVACY_DIAL：加密通话。

INTERNAL：内部呼叫。

PREDICTIVE：预测式外呼。

INBOUND：呼入。

CONFERENCE：会议
parameters.name: contact_type_list

parameters.help_en:
A list of call dispositions to include in the results.

Valid values:

`AbandonedInQueue`: The call was abandoned in the queue.

`NoAnswer`: The call was not answered by the customer.

`QueuingTimeout`: The call timed out in the queue.

`Voicemail`: The call was transferred to voicemail.

`QueuingFailed`: The call failed to be transferred to an agent.

`QueuingOverflow`: The queue overflowed.

`AbandonedInVoiceNavigator`: The call was abandoned in the voice navigator.

`Success`: The call ended normally.

`IVRException`: An IVR exception occurred.

`AbandonedInRing`: The call was abandoned during ringing.

`AbandonedInIVR`: The call was abandoned in the IVR.

`Reject`: The call was rejected by the customer.

`ForwardToOutsideNumber`: The call was forwarded to an external number
parameters.help_zh:
按挂断原因列表过滤。

枚举值：

AbandonedInQueue：排队放弃。

NoAnswer：客户未接。

QueuingTimeout：排队超时。

Voicemail：转语音邮箱。

QueuingFailed：转人工失败。

QueuingOverflow：排队溢出。

AbandonedInVoiceNavigator：智能导航中放弃。

Success：正常结束。

IVRException：IVR异常。

AbandonedInRing：振铃放弃。

AbandonedInIVR：IVR放弃。

Reject：客户拒接。

ForwardToOutsideNumber：转外线
parameters.name: contact_disposition_list

parameters.help_en:
Filters the results by a list of reasons for call connection failure.

Valid values:

`NoAnswer`: No answer.

`OutOfService`: The number is out of service.

`NotExist`: The number does not exist.

`Restricted`: The call is restricted.

`Busy`: The line is busy.

`NotConnected`: Could not connect.

`PowerOff`: The phone is powered off
parameters.help_zh:
按未接通原因列表过滤。

枚举值：

NoAnswer：无人接听。

OutOfService：停机。

NotExist：空号。

Restricted：呼叫受限。

Busy：占线。

NotConnected：无法接通。

PowerOff：关机
parameters.name: early_media_state_list

parameters.help_en:
The channel for the satisfaction survey.

Valid values:

`IVR`: IVR-based survey.

`SMS`: SMS-based survey.

`CHAT`: chat-based survey
parameters.help_zh:
满意度调查渠道。

枚举值：

IVR：语音满意度。

SMS：短信满意度。

CHAT: 消息满意度
parameters.name: satisfaction_survey_channel

parameters.help_en:
Filters the results by satisfaction ratings. The value is a JSON array of strings. The array can contain rating values or comparison expressions.

Valid values:

`-2`: The survey was not sent.

`-1`: The customer did not provide a rating.

Other positive integers: Custom rating values
parameters.help_zh:
按满意度列表过滤，多个满意度结果使用英文逗号隔开。

枚举值：

-2：未发送。

-1：未评价。

其他正数：自定义满意度评价数值
parameters.name: satisfaction_rate_list

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by a list of user-defined satisfaction descriptions
parameters.help_zh: 按满意度描述列表过滤，描述内容由客户自定义
parameters.name: satisfaction_description_list

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by a list of skill group IDs
parameters.help_zh: 坐席所属技能组ID列表
parameters.name: skill_group_id_list

parameters.help_en: The agent ID
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the first agent who joined the call
parameters.help_zh: 首个参与通话的坐席ID
parameters.name: first_agent_id

parameters.help_en: The calling number
parameters.help_zh: 主叫号码
parameters.name: calling_number

parameters.help_en: The called number
parameters.help_zh: 被叫号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en: The phone number
parameters.help_zh: 电话号码
parameters.name: number

parameters.help_en: The broker number. It must be an outbound number available in the instance. For a back-to-back call, the system uses this number to call the calling number and the called number in sequence
parameters.help_zh: 中间号码，需要是实例下可用的外呼号码，双呼时会使用该号码先后呼叫主叫和被叫
parameters.name: broker

parameters.help_en:
A list of visitor channel types to include in the results.

Valid values:

`Web`: Web.

`DingTalkServiceWindow`: DingTalk service window.

`AliMe`: chatbot.

`DingTalkRobot`: DingTalk robot
parameters.help_zh:
访客渠道类型列表。

Web: 网页。

AliMe：对话机器人。

DingTalkRobot：钉钉机器人

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by the party that initiated the call release
parameters.help_zh: 挂断方
parameters.name: release_initiator_list

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by the release reason
parameters.help_zh: 挂断原因
parameters.name: release_reason_list

parameters.help_zh: AI话后分析报告是否已完成
